mentions.name: Aepbase
mentions.description: An open-source backend-in-a-box that ties the AEP API ecosystem together. Users run a single binary and define the schema for a resource with one API call, getting a full set of CRUD APIs plus support for a resource-oriented CLI, Terraform provider, MCP server, and UI with near-zero configuration.
mentions.source_excerpt: I’ve been working on an OSS backend-in-a-box called [aepbase](https://aepbase.io/).
